fichas.title: Visual perception and architectural scale
fichas.summary: Illustrations demonstrate optical effects involving contrast, colour, pattern, figure-ground perception, perspective, and visual alignment. The page also explains how apparent building scale can be changed by vertical versus horizontal proportions, wall curvature, and the ratio and layout of window openings, even when building and storey heights remain the same.
uses: Understanding visual perception in architectural design
Assessing how contrast, colour, and pattern affect perceived size and proportion
Understanding how building articulation and window layouts affect perceived scale
